ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Let one mother kangaroo jump have length M. The little kangaroo's jump is three times shorter, so one little kangaroo jump is M/3. The distance equal to 7 jumps of the mother is 7M. The number of little kangaroo jumps needed is 7M ÷ (M/3) = 7 × 3 = 21.
